shared_elements: human figure with head, arms and torso
carved relief detailing on a stone surface
circular disc/roundel motif (on the statue's chest; rosette-like elements in the frieze)
justification: Both depict human figures with indicated headgear/hair and garment detail, and both include disc-like roundels, but these are the most generic possible correspondences. A shows a single frontal, blocky anthropomorphic figure whose body serves as the field for schematic incised symbols including a large chest disc, while B shows a horizontal band of repeated naturalistic profile figures walking in file and carrying objects, a wholly different compositional and stylistic scheme.
